raw_text:
This is a **chezmoi dotfiles repository** managing configurations across machines.

Source: `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` → Target: `~/` via `chezmoi apply` (copies, not symlinks). Repository: https://github.com/pascalandy/dotfiles

Files in `~/` managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly. Always edit the source in `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` or use `chezmoi edit`.

chezmoi managed | grep <filename>
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc
chezmoi add ~/.newfile
git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push
chezmoi cat ~/.zshrc

Prefixes: `dot_` means leading `.`, `private_` applies `600`/`700`, `executable_` applies execute permission, `symlink_` creates symlink, `.tmpl` processes `{{ }}`, `run_before_` runs before apply, `run_after_` after every apply, `run_once_` only first apply.

Store scripts in `~/.local/bin/`; do not use `.sh` extensions:
code ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
Stored as `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`. Ensure PATH:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

All bash scripts follow:
`dot_config/opencode/skill/bash/scripts/pref_bash_script_template.sh`
set -euo pipefail

Naming: `fct_*` functions, `log_*` logging, `UPPER_CASE` constants/env vars, `lower_case` locals.
Use `log_info "Starting process"` and `log_error "Something failed"`.

Files containing `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension. Define variables in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`.

See `.chezmoiignore` for excluded `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `.env*`, `.DS_Store`. See `crash_procedure.md` for recovery. Docs: https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/command-overview/

Before solving from scratch, search cass for prior solutions. ⚠️ NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5
cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json
cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json
cass capabilities --json
cass robot-docs guide

`--fields minimal` returns essential data; use `--limit N`, `--agent NAME`, `--days N`. stdout = data only, stderr = diagnostics. Exit 0 = success.
